title: Counter service
caption: The owner said they were out of the swamp special.
blurb: A small alligator entered a bagel shop in Southport, North Carolina, through the back door and stood at the front counter. The owner called 911, and no one was hurt.
alt_text: An alligator at a bagel shop counter, with the owner holding a chair.

title: Cow convention
caption: The real cow had been saying for years that nobody would notice.
blurb: A basketball team in Frederick, Maryland, set a world record when 1,902 fans dressed as cows at their annual event. The previous record was set in Australia in 2014.
alt_text: A crowd in cow costumes, with a real cow in the front row wearing the same costume.

title: The raccoon memorial
caption: A quarter mile of traffic waited to view the memorial.
blurb: Two brothers on Bainbridge Island built a fourteen-foot animatronic raccoon as a Halloween decoration. The giant creature drew long lines of visiting cars and required internal maintenance through a rear access hatch.
alt_text: Two small raccoons gaze up at a giant mechanical raccoon with glowing eyes in a front yard.

title: Patient audience
caption: The pigs appreciated the thirty-two hours of preparation.
blurb: A record-breaking pumpkin weighing over three thousand pounds was carved into the heaviest jack-o-lantern ever in Salem, Massachusetts. After Halloween the decorated gourd was donated as feed for pigs.
alt_text: Two pigs watch from behind a fence as someone carves a gigantic jack-o-lantern.

title: Night scrub
caption: The neighborhood had started leaving them the filthier ones.
blurb: A couple in Brighton began cleaning grimy road signs and posting the process online as an ASMR channel. They said the reveal of clean metal beneath the dirt was satisfying, and locals began recommending signs for them to tackle.
alt_text: Two raccoons clean a road sign at night while one films with a camera on a tripod.

title: The alligator's final game
caption: He had won the sweepstakes, but the alligator played through the tutorial first.
blurb: Microsoft built a single functioning Xbox Series X inside a five-foot animatronic alligator to promote a sweepstakes. The creature was constructed by John Nolan Studio and designed to hold game discs in its mouth.
alt_text: A man inserts a game disc into the mouth of a motionless animatronic alligator; the alligator's eyes glow red.

title: Peacock bathroom critic
caption: He had a few notes on the lighting.
blurb: A peacock named Hex escaped his enclosure and broke into a home in Queensland, Australia. He was found admiring his reflection in the bathroom mirror, prompting a social-media search before being reunited with his peahen.
alt_text: A peacock standing on a bathroom sink gestures at his reflection with a raised wing, while a man in a bathrobe peers around the door.

title: Alligator at the counter
caption: He had not ordered the everything bagel.
blurb: A three-foot alligator entered a bagel shop in Southport, North Carolina, through the back door. A customer grabbed a chair for protection, but police and animal control captured the reptile without incident and relocated it.
alt_text: A small alligator stands at a bagel shop counter on its hind legs, while a man in an apron presses against the wall holding a chair in front of him.

title: Tarantula travel conditions
caption: His connecting flight was delayed.
blurb: Peruvian authorities seized over 3,000 live tarantulas hidden inside dirty socks in suitcases at Lima airport, bound for Germany. Two Germans and a Polish citizen were arrested in what authorities said was a large-scale smuggling operation worth up to 1.5 million euros.
alt_text: Two panels: first, a tarantula with a baggage tag sits curled in a sock; second, it sits alone on an empty conveyor belt with a leg raised as if hailing a ride.

title: Fence post identification
caption: It was the only fence post that had moved in a month.
blurb: A North Carolina farmer spotted what he thought was a fence post lying on the ground until it turned out to be a missing boa constrictor. The snake had escaped a month earlier and was discovered when the farmer got close enough to see it moving.
alt_text: A very long brown boa constrictor lies perfectly straight and still on grass next to a fence, as a farmer in a straw hat reaches toward it with a repair tool.

title: Cow Evades Capture
caption: She had been waiting to see if he would figure out the knot.
blurb: A large cow escaped in Marshfield, Massachusetts and evaded capture for over a full day. Police warned drivers to watch out, and a local man brought his horse and lasso from a couple hours away to try to wrangle the cow back home.
alt_text: A large black-and-white cow stands in a suburban backyard with a lasso looped over one horn, chewing calmly. A man on a horse stares from a fence, holding the other end of the lasso, looking confused.
